The shelf is extended horizontally.

View beneath/along the shelf suggests it is being returned toward its folded position.
Shelf no longer presents as a broad horizontal work surface.

User pulls the shelf into a horizontal working position.

notes: Five localized manipulation episodes are visible: one lounge-chair adjustment followed by four distinct barbecue-part episodes. The two foldable shelf timings are less exact because strong camera roll makes horizontal versus folded orientations harder to distinguish.
scene_description: A covered apartment balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a stainless-steel propane barbecue beside a sliding glass door and wooden wall trellis.
